g.text: TenantId of a tenant-owned table: the column the query filter and the policy match.
PK primary key · FK foreign key · UQ unique · IX index · NOT NULL / NULL nullability.
Edge: crow's foot = many, bar = exactly one. Every client belongs to one tenant and one plan; both keys ON DELETE RESTRICT.
Not shown: the roles control_plane_owner and control_plane_app, and EF Core's __EFMigrationsHistory.
